name: HaMitnachel (המתנחל)
overview: *HaMitnahel* ("The Settler") is an Israeli comedic documentary reality show in which Hanoch Daum lives in the homes of celebrities for 48 hours to help advance their lives. The show premiered on December 25, 2013, on Channel 10, where it aired for two seasons; its third season aired on Reshet 13 until it concluded on April 4, 2019.
